scope: Scope-only metadata clarifications, not source-equation audits. Preserve existing formulaType, sourceIds, sourceLocations, metadataReview, reviewedAt and curationBatch. Do not set metadataReview explicit on the basis of this file.

assumptions: Single photon or single-mode energy quantum; not the total energy of a multimode state.
variables: E: energy quantum; h: Planck constant; nu: cyclic frequency; hbar=h/(2 pi); omega=2 pi nu.
updates.units: SI: E in joules, h and hbar in joule seconds, nu in hertz, omega in radians per second.
updates.regime: Radiation energy quantum; zero-point energy is not included.

assumptions: Free photon in vacuum; lambda is vacuum wavelength and p is momentum magnitude.
variables: p: nonnegative photon momentum magnitude; lambda: wavelength; k=2 pi/lambda: wave-number magnitude.
updates.units: SI: p in kg m/s, lambda in m, k in inverse m.
updates.regime: Do not apply without qualification to canonical versus kinetic momentum of light inside a material.

assumptions: Momentum eigenmode or locally narrow momentum distribution.
variables: lambda: wavelength; p: magnitude of momentum; h: Planck constant.
updates.units: SI: wavelength in m and momentum in kg m/s.
updates.regime: A localized wave packet generally contains a range of wavelengths; p=0 gives an infinite wavelength limit.

assumptions: Closed nonrelativistic quantum system with a self-adjoint Hamiltonian on the relevant state domain.
variables: Psi(r,t): position-space state amplitude; H: Hamiltonian; t: time; hbar: reduced Planck constant.
updates.units: H has energy units; both sides have energy times wavefunction units. In 3D single-particle normalization, Psi has units m^(-3/2).
updates.regime: First-order time evolution; for spin or many particles the state and coordinates must be extended. Not a general relativistic field equation.

assumptions: Time-independent Hamiltonian; psi_n belongs to its operator domain.
variables: psi_n: energy eigenstate; E_n: corresponding energy eigenvalue; H: Hamiltonian.
updates.units: H and E_n have energy units.
updates.regime: Spectral eigenvalue problem; continuum eigenstates may require generalized normalization, and the displayed discrete subscript does not imply every spectrum is discrete.

assumptions: Normalized pure state in a position representation; any internal components must be summed in the norm.
variables: P(r,t): probability density, not probability at one exact point; Psi: wavefunction.
updates.units: For 3D position, P has inverse-volume units and Psi has inverse-square-root-volume units.
updates.regime: Probability for a region is the integral of P over that region.

assumptions: Normalized pure state and orthogonal projector P_a=P_a dagger=P_a squared for the measurement event.
variables: psi: unit state vector; P_a: projector onto the event subspace; p(a): outcome probability.
updates.units: p(a) and the projector are dimensionless.
updates.regime: Projective measurement, including degenerate eigenspaces; a general measurement uses positive POVM effects rather than necessarily projectors.

assumptions: rho is positive, trace one; each E_a is a positive measurement effect and the effects sum to identity.
variables: rho: density operator; E_a: POVM effect; p(a): event probability.
updates.regime: Applies to pure or mixed states and generalized measurements; the effect does not alone determine the post-measurement state.

assumptions: Normalized pure state for the bra-ket expression; rho positive and trace one for the trace expression.
The observable is self-adjoint and the state has a finite expectation on its appropriate domain.
variables: A: observable; rho: density operator; psi: state; angle brackets: ensemble expectation.
updates.units: The expectation has the same units as A.
updates.regime: The pure-state and density-operator expressions agree when rho is the pure-state projector; an expectation need not be an eigenvalue observed in one trial.

assumptions: Square-integrable single-particle wavefunction on all 3D position space; include internal-state norm if present.
updates.units: Psi has units length^(-3/2); the integral is dimensionless.
updates.regime: Not ordinary normalization of ideal position or momentum eigenkets, which use delta-function normalization.

assumptions: Cartesian position and its canonical conjugate momentum on a common suitable dense domain.
variables: x: one coordinate operator; p: its canonical momentum; i: imaginary unit; hbar: reduced Planck constant.
updates.regime: For multiple Cartesian coordinates, [x_i,p_j]=i hbar delta_ij; this is not the algebra of arbitrary angular or compact coordinates.

assumptions: The products AB and BA are defined on the common domain of interest.
updates.units: Commutator units are the product of the units of A and B.
updates.regime: Algebraic definition, not an independent dynamical law.

assumptions: Canonical x and p with finite variances and sufficient common-domain regularity.
variables: Delta x and Delta p: standard deviations in the same quantum state, not instrumental errors.
updates.regime: State-preparation variance bound; it is not a general measurement-disturbance relation.

assumptions: Closed-system evolution generated by a self-adjoint time-independent Hamiltonian for the displayed exponential.
variables: U(t,t0): unitary propagator; H: Hamiltonian; t0: initial time; psi: state vector.
updates.regime: For noncommuting Hamiltonians at different times, replace the simple exponential by the time-ordered propagator.

assumptions: Closed-system unitary evolution, or the full system including environment; H is self-adjoint.
variables: rho: density operator; H: Hamiltonian; [H,rho]: commutator.
updates.units: Both sides have energy units because rho is dimensionless.
updates.regime: Not a generic reduced open-system equation: tracing out an environment may introduce dissipative and memory terms.
